selection_rule: If consumer only needs exact bytes as data/semantic state, prefer canonical base16 for checker simplicity at tiny scale. If a repository binary file itself is material, use Git Data base64 blob -> base-tree -> commit -> force=false ref update with stale-parent reconstruction and exact base64/path SHA readback.
transversal_gain: The Git Data route eliminates two earlier dependency classes at once in the tested scope: non-UTF-8 binary materialization and concurrent publication recovery. It reuses the same content identity, immutable derivation and fail-closed CAS principles as text state.
remaining_boundary: Do not generalize to large artifacts, executable builds, multi-file atomicity, or non-repository side effects. Canonical base64 must be verified by the caller; server acceptance is not a validator.
